name: UserBob
description_en:
UserBob purchases remote, unmoderated feedback videos from people trying a website or app. The client supplies a scenario and task; participants record their screens while thinking aloud. It is a research service, rather than a prototype editor or an automatic heatmap system.

The useful output is a set of individual observations to review. A confusing label or failed task can guide the next design change, but a small set of videos cannot establish a conversion lift or population-wide preference.
description_zh:
UserBob 提供远程、无主持人的网站或应用反馈视频。委托方编写场景和任务，参与者边操作边口述，并录制屏幕。它是研究服务，而非原型编辑器或自动热力图系统。

实际产出是可逐条查看的观察记录。标签难懂或任务失败可以帮助确定下一步设计改动，但少量视频不能证明转化提升或整体人群偏好。

core_features.explanation_en: Participants record a supplied website or app task with verbal feedback.
core_features.explanation_zh: 参与者录制指定网站或应用任务，并口述反馈。

core_features.name_zh: 按设备区分的测试组合
core_features.explanation_en: The order page separates Web, Mobile Web, Android and iOS tests.
core_features.explanation_zh: 下单页区分 Web、Mobile Web、Android 和 iOS 测试。

use_cases.basis: Illustrative workflow and selection guidance, not observed customer outcomes.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: No subscription required; test prices depend on device, participant count and video length.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 无需订阅；费用取决于设备、人数和视频时长。

sources.title: UserBob - Affordable usability testing
sources.research_notes_en: Read service workflow, first-impression versus task studies, agency/API positioning and no-subscription statement.

sources.title: UserBob - Create Test
sources.research_notes_en: Read actual order page after /pricing redirects; package prices differ by platform and deliverable.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The homepage separates a short first-impression test from a longer attempt to complete a task. It describes recruiting participants and allowing demographic choices. Choose the question first: whether visitors understand the proposition differs from whether they can finish an application. The homepage describes US users; do not assume that a chosen audience is available in every country.
sections.zh: 首页区分短时第一印象测试和较长的任务完成测试，并介绍参与者招募与人口特征选择。应先明确问题：访客是否理解产品，与能否完成申请，是两项不同研究。首页描述的是美国用户，不能假定所有国家都有合适样本。

sections.en: For an illustrative shop study, give participants a realistic purchase scenario and ask them to find the return window. Avoid telling them which menu to open. Order the intended device type, review every recording, and note the exact point at which the participant hesitates. Keep wrong answers as evidence rather than treating task completion alone as success. No study was commissioned here.
sections.zh: 以商店研究为例，可以提供真实感的购买场景，请参与者寻找退货期限，不要告诉他们打开哪个菜单。选择目标设备类型，逐条查看录屏，记录犹豫发生的位置。错误答案也应保留，不能仅以操作完成判断成功。本文没有实际委托研究。

sections.title_en: Pay for a defined video package
sections.title_zh: 按明确的视频组合付费
sections.en: The order page shows Web first impressions as 20 one-minute videos for $30 and Web task completion as five five-minute videos for $37.50. Mobile Web first impressions instead shows nine one-minute videos for $22.50. Android and iOS options have their own packages, and custom tests expose participant count, duration and demographics. These are different deliverables, not a single monthly starting price. The homepage says no subscription is required. Confirm the selected package before ordering.
sections.zh: 下单页列出 Web 第一印象组合为 20 条各一分钟的视频，共 30 美元；Web 任务完成组合为五条各五分钟的视频，共 37.50 美元。Mobile Web 第一印象则为九条各一分钟的视频，共 22.50 美元。Android、iOS 有各自组合，自定义测试另选人数、时长和人口特征。这些交付物不同，不能归成一个月起价。首页说明无需订阅，购买前应核对所选组合。

sections.title_en: Prepare an accessible task before ordering
sections.title_zh: 下单前准备可访问的任务
sections.en: Create a client account and choose Web, Mobile Web, Android or iOS rather than assuming all participants use the same environment. Supply the URL or app and a scenario that does not expose real customer credentials. Pilot the wording and decide which observations would change the design. For agency workflows the homepage mentions white labeling and a REST API, but implementation and commercial terms require separate confirmation.
sections.zh: 创建委托方账户，选择 Web、Mobile Web、Android 或 iOS，不能假定所有参与者使用相同环境。提供网址或应用，并设计不暴露真实客户凭据的场景。先检查任务措辞，明确哪些观察会改变设计。首页提到代理商白标服务和 REST API，但接入方式与商业条款仍需另外确认。

sections.title_en: Feedback is not an outcome guarantee
sections.en: Use UserBob when a scoped task and screen recording can answer the question. A complex longitudinal study or a live interview requiring repeated follow-up may need another method. The site advertises refunds or replacement tests when results disappoint; this is a service promise, not independently verified turnaround or participant quality. Review the current support and order terms before relying on a remedy. Source-code licensing, data retention and contractual sharing rights remain unverified.
sections.zh: 当范围明确的任务和录屏足以回答问题时，可以考虑 UserBob。长期追踪或需要连续追问的实时访谈可能需要其他方法。网站宣传结果不满意时退款或重做，这是服务承诺，并非本文验证的交付时效或参与者质量。依赖补救措施前应核对当前支持和订单条款。源码许可、数据保留及合同分享权仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: API entitlements, retention, contractual video reuse and current audience coverage need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: API 权益、保留期限、视频合同复用权和当前人群覆盖仍需确认。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
